# turbo-flow-wizard

> Interactive setup wizard that generates project-specific CLAUDE.md configuration files for Claude Code integration. Supports 12 app types, 7 development methodologies, and 19 feature sets.

turbo-flow-wizard is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).

- [Landing page](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/turbo-flow-wizard/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/adventurewave-labs/turbo-flow-wizard): README, issues, releases
